title: Deletion
description: Metadata block attached to every soft-deleted record. The five core fields are universal across any producer. The optional context bag holds source-specific fields so the core contract stays generic and reusable.

deletedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC, millisecond precision) at which the record was soft-deleted. Server-stamped.

deletedBy.description: User ID of the actor who performed the deletion. Server-stamped from UserContext.

intent.description: Why the record was deleted. Allowed values enforced at the api-layer.

reason.description: More specific reason for the deletion. Allowed values enforced at the api-layer.

reasonText.description: Free-text explanation. Required when reason is OTHER; otherwise optional.

context.description: Open bag for source-specific metadata. Credentialing places workflowId here. Kept outside the core fields so this schema stays reusable for scalar attributes and future use cases such as pinning.
